output.summary: Perennial aquatic plant native to temperate and subtropical parts of Africa, Asia, Australia and the Americas. It has bright green floating leaves, small purple flowers and thick mucilage coating its underwater parts. Its young mucilage-covered stems are eaten in China and Japan, including in soups.
output.edibilityNote: Young mucilage-covered stems are eaten as a vegetable in China and Japan, including in regional soups.
